title: Book Two · Chapter 155: The Longer Road
story:
Leo comes to the green door on Sunday with a ball under his arm. Ronan has his practice folder open on the table.

“Are you free?” Leo asks.

“For a game?”

“For a walk first. My aunt is here. The house has too many questions in it.”

Ronan puts away the folder. He tells Mum the route, and they leave together. The ball stays under Leo's arm until they reach the river path.

“Questions about school?” Ronan asks.

Leo nods. His family is looking at a school in another city. He could go there for the next part of his studies. A relative lives there. The family can visit during a holiday, but no one has decided yet.

“Is it better?” Ronan asks.

“It has some classes I want. It is also far away.”

“Would you live with your aunt?”

“Perhaps. My parents are looking at other plans too.”

Leo drops the ball and stops it with his foot. Ronan looks at the water through the low fence.

“Then why try for the reading group here?”

“Because I am here now. I want to do that work.”

“But if you leave—”

“The group will work here this school year. I am not leaving tomorrow.”

Ronan nods. He wishes he could take back his question. Leo kicks the ball gently toward him.

They use two fallen leaves as goal marks. The path is quiet, and they keep their game on the empty square beside it. Leo scores first. Ronan scores twice, then sends the ball over his own goal line.

“A very kind shot,” Leo says.

“I want you to enjoy your visit.”

“I am still living here.”

Ronan laughs. They start again.

On the walk home, Leo stops at a food stall. He has enough money for one warm bun. He buys it. He pulls it into two unequal pieces.

“Choose,” he says.

Ronan takes the smaller piece.

“That was too quick,” Leo says. “Now I look greedy.”

“You can still give me some.”

Leo breaks off another bite and hands it over. They eat beside the river. Ronan asks about the new city's weather. Leo does not know. He asks Ronan about the third practice task. Ronan does not know that either.

At the turn for River Street, Leo picks a crumb from his sleeve.

“I will tell you when we decide,” he says.

“Yes.”

They take the longer road because a cart fills the narrow lane. Ronan does not ask Leo to stay. He talks about the ball he kicked into his own goal. Leo laughs all the way to Mr Qiu's table.

1. Leo为什么仍然认真争取本校资料小组的机会？
2. 两个朋友暂时不知道哪些事情？
